lines.text: In the fourth year of Jehoiakim, the first year of Nebuchadnezzar, Jeremiah spoke to all Judah and Jerusalem's residents.
For twenty-three years the LORD's word came to Jeremiah, and the people did not listen to him or the prophets.
The prophets said to turn from evil ways and not follow other gods, and the LORD would do no harm.
The LORD will send for His servant Cyrus king of Persia, and the nations will serve Babylon for seventy years.
When seventy years are complete, the LORD will punish Babylon, and many nations and great kings will enslave the Egyptians.
